title: Wingie Enuygun MCP
description: Search and compare flights, hotels, buses, and car rentals with ENUYGUN's MCP.
summary: Search and compare flights, hotels, buses, and car rentals with ENUYGUN's MCP.
offersHint: Search and compare flights, hotels, buses, and car rentals with ENUYGUN's MCP. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.enuygun.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: flight_search
toolsPreview.description: Search for flights between cities and airports. Find available flights with schedules, pricing, airline information, and seat availability for domestic and international travel.

toolsPreview.name: flight_allocate
toolsPreview.description: Generate booking URL for selected flight options. Creates a personalized booking link that directs users to complete their flight reservation with pre-filled search criteria and selected flights.

toolsPreview.name: flight_weather_forecast
toolsPreview.description: Get weather forecast for flight destinations and travel dates. Provides detailed weather predictions including temperature, precipitation, visibility, and wind conditions to help plan air travel safely.

toolsPreview.name: car_search
toolsPreview.description: Search for car rental options between cities. Find available vehicles with pricing, specifications, and rental terms for specific dates and locations.

toolsPreview.name: car_allocate
toolsPreview.description: Generate a booking URL for selected car rental option. Creates a reservation link that can be used to complete the car rental booking process.

toolsPreview.name: car_weather_forecast
toolsPreview.description: Get weather forecast for car travel destinations. Provides detailed weather predictions including temperature, precipitation, and road conditions for optimal travel planning.

toolsPreview.name: hotel_room_detail
toolsPreview.description: Get detailed room information, prices, and images for a specific hotel. Provides comprehensive hotel details including room types, pricing, facilities, images, and policies.

toolsPreview.name: hotel_search
toolsPreview.description: Search for hotels in a destination with comprehensive filtering and pagination options.

toolsPreview.name: hotel_weather_forecast
toolsPreview.description: Get weather forecast for hotel destinations and stay periods. Provides detailed weather predictions including temperature, precipitation, and outdoor activity conditions to help plan hotel stays and local activities.

toolsPreview.name: bus_search
toolsPreview.description: Search for bus routes between cities. Find available buses with schedules, pricing, seat availability, and operator information for intercity travel.

toolsPreview.name: bus_weather_forecast
toolsPreview.description: Get weather forecast for bus travel destinations. Provides detailed weather predictions including temperature, precipitation, and road conditions to help plan bus journeys safely.
